Adding a short technical runbook and owners so we have a single place to track dependencies. I pulled items from the MAP draft and the call notes.

POC Environment Setup — Milestones (suggested):
1) VPC peering & routing (Owner: Acme - Alex / Redwood - Ben)
   - Tasks: Create peering connection, update route tables, enable flow logs for perf debugging.
   - Target: 2026-03-03 (depends on security window)
   - Dependencies: Acme security approval, firewall rule window.

2) IP allowlist / Firewall (Owner: Acme - Alex / Redwood - Ben)
   - Tasks: Redwood provides outbound IP ranges; Acme adds to firewall/NGFW rules.
   - Target: 2026-03-03
   - Note: We'll provide a small CIDR set + FQDNs for egress if useful.

3) SSO / SAML integration (Owner: Acme - Priya / Redwood - Ben)
   - Tasks: Exchange metadata, configure Okta app for test users, map attributes (email, groups).
   - Target: 2026-03-05
   - Dependencies: Okta admin access and test user creation.

4) Secrets / KMS access (Owner: Acme SecOps / Redwood Eng)
   - Tasks: Decide between customer-managed KMS key or Redwood-managed; if customer-managed, provide key ARN and grant decrypt for Redwood service principal.
   - Target: 2026-03-05

5) Smoke test & validation (Owner: Redwood Eng / Acme Eng)
   - Tasks: Validate connectivity, run a short inference workload, check logs/latency.
   - Target: 2026-03-06

I can draft a short runbook with CLI commands we expect for peering/routing and a sample SAML metadata exchange doc if that's helpful.
